title: Soft budget: a handler running past the elicited budget fires cronStalled and continues
asA: operator observing long-running scheduled work on a Worker
iWant: the dispatcher to fire cronStalled at the moment a handler's observed duration crosses the elicited soft budget, without terminating the handler
soThat: the applied logging companion surfaces stalled fires as a first-class signal, and the Worker's own CPU budget stays the vendor's concern

acceptanceCriteria.description: With softBudgetMs=100 and a spy handler that resolves after 250ms of fake-clock time, dispatching fires exactly one cronStalled event on the sink with {event, expression, scheduledTime, outcome: stalled, duration: >=100, softBudgetMs: 100} at the moment the observed duration crosses 100ms.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher configured with softBudgetMs=100 and a spy handler that resolves after 250ms of fake-clock time
acceptanceCriteria.then: exactly one cronStalled event fires with the observed duration at or past the budget

acceptanceCriteria.description: With softBudgetMs=100 and a spy handler that resolves after 250ms of fake-clock time, the dispatcher does NOT terminate the handler on the soft-budget breach; the handler runs to completion and a final cronFired event follows the cronStalled record with the total observed duration.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher configured with softBudgetMs=100 and a spy handler that resolves after 250ms of fake-clock time
acceptanceCriteria.then: the handler runs to completion and a cronFired follows the cronStalled record

acceptanceCriteria.description: Handler throws BEFORE the soft-budget crossing: with softBudgetMs=100 and a spy handler that rejects at 50ms of fake-clock time with an application error, the dispatcher fires exactly one cronFailed event on the sink with {event:"cronFailed", expression, scheduledTime, outcome:"failed", duration:>=50}; no cronStalled and no cronFired emits for that dispatch. The error propagates through the returned dispatch promise.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher with softBudgetMs=100 and a spy handler that rejects at 50ms of fake-clock time
acceptanceCriteria.then: exactly one cronFailed event fires with outcome:"failed"; no cronStalled or cronFired emits

acceptanceCriteria.description: Handler throws AFTER the soft-budget crossing: with softBudgetMs=100 and a spy handler that rejects at 250ms of fake-clock time, the dispatcher fires cronStalled at the 100ms crossing then cronFailed at the 250ms rejection with {outcome:"failed", duration:>=250}; no cronFired emits for that dispatch.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher with softBudgetMs=100 and a spy handler that rejects at 250ms of fake-clock time
acceptanceCriteria.then: cronStalled fires at 100ms, cronFailed fires at 250ms, and no cronFired emits

acceptanceCriteria.description: Exact-boundary at softBudgetMs: with softBudgetMs=100 and a spy handler that resolves at EXACTLY 100ms of fake-clock time, the dispatcher fires cronFired only (no cronStalled). The soft-budget observer treats the crossing as strict greater-than: a duration equal to softBudgetMs does not trip the stall record.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher with softBudgetMs=100 and a spy handler that resolves at 100ms of fake-clock time
acceptanceCriteria.then: only cronFired emits; no cronStalled record fires at the boundary

acceptanceCriteria.description: Idempotency: a single dispatch produces exactly one cronStalled record even if the internal soft-budget observer re-arms or the setTimeout is re-scheduled. A test that observes the sink after a stall-then-complete cycle finds cronStalled.length === 1 and cronFired.length === 1 for that dispatch.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher with softBudgetMs=100 and a spy handler that resolves at 500ms
acceptanceCriteria.when: an event is dispatched and the sink is inspected after completion
acceptanceCriteria.then: cronStalled records for that dispatch count exactly one; cronFired records count exactly one
